author: ShaojieZhuIntel
title: Debian Packages job fails - apt-get cannot reach azure.archive.ubuntu.com (connection timed out)
signature: Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com connection timed out|Network

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get update fails with connection timed out to azure.archive.ubuntu.com

key_errors:
Err:1 http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu jammy InRelease
  Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (X.X.X.X), connection timed out
root_cause: The GitHub Actions runner hosting the Debian Packages job could not reach azure.archive.ubuntu.com on port 80 during apt-get update. This is a transient network connectivity issue on the Azure-hosted runner infrastructure, not related to the PR changes. The run was automatically retried (attempt 2) and is currently progressing successfully.
reproduction_steps: N/A - infrastructure/network issue not reproducible outside CI
recommended_actions: No code change needed - the failure is a transient network issue
If the pattern persists, consider adding retry logic to apt-get update in the Debian Packages workflow
prevention_strategies: Consider adding apt-get retry logic (e.g., --retry flag or looping) in the Debian Packages job steps. The azure.archive.ubuntu.com mirror experiences intermittent unreachability from GitHub Actions runners.
historical_context: This is the 5th occurrence of this pattern (signature 7d2e2ff59d37c6b4). Previous occurrences on 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-19, all resolved by retry. See runs: 32152602590, 32152867988, 32212108817, 32222069742.
